scope: Secondary evidence only: scheduled first expected sample to its receipt and first representing draw start. Not callback completion, visible ink, or physical pen-to-screen latency; camera pending. Generated replay bypasses the Wacom digitizer and driver. No primary metric, threshold, or backend selection is changed.
aggregation_warning: A whole 30-second run p95 can dilute a one-time first-mark cost. These rows identify the first expected sample, not the latest sample represented by the first frame.
host_launch_scope: The host_launch clock starts at the first Swift statement, not the OS process-launch request. It includes the explicit one-second autostart wait and replay/reference construction. For after-idle runs it also includes warm-up, reset, cache preparation and idle waiting; it is not first-mark latency. Initialization stages are reported separately as recorded.
draw_wall_scope: First-frame synchronous callback wall duration includes the backend-specific draw path and possible drawable acquisition. Core Graphics can rasterize after callback return; process CPU and optical endpoints have different scopes.
